verdict: Spend collapsed to under $4 on the latest day — the PCOS and Postpartum campaign has effectively gone dark.
diagnosis: You spent $2,330 over 28 days on one Facebook lead campaign, but daily spend fell from the $13 average to $3.85 — pacing has broken.

signals.headline: Total spend hit $2,330 this period
signals.detail: All of it went to a single lead campaign targeting PCOS and postpartum audiences. No diversification, no backup.

signals.headline: Daily spend crashed to $3.85
signals.detail: Latest day is 72% below the $13.63 daily average. Budget cap, payment issue, or manual pause is likely.

signals.headline: 346,446 impressions delivered in 28 days
signals.detail: Reach is healthy for a single-campaign account, but with no lead or conversion data reported, efficiency cannot be judged.

signals.headline: Zero visibility across 4 channels
signals.detail: No Google Business Profile, organic, social, or CRM data feeding in. You are flying blind on everything except paid.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: The fitness category averages roughly $19.50 per lead on Meta, well below the $27.66 all-industry average. Boutique studios typically pay $25–$50 per lead depending on positioning.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: September 2025 was the year's costliest month for fitness leads at around $60. Expect elevated auction pressure in September before Q4 relief.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: Pilates and hybrid formats leading demand
competitor.body: Pilates now represents over 43% of primary studio modalities. Boutique studios winning in 2026 are leaning into community, low-impact strength, and hybrid fusion formats over transactional group fitness.

recommendations.title: Investigate why daily spend dropped to $3.85
recommendations.detail: Check for budget caps, billing failures, or ad disapproval. A campaign delivering $13/day average that suddenly drops to $3 usually signals a technical break, not audience fatigue.

recommendations.title: Connect lead and conversion tracking this week
recommendations.detail: Without lead volume, cost per lead cannot be measured against the $19.50 fitness benchmark. Consider wiring Facebook lead forms into your booking system or CRM.

recommendations.title: Test a second campaign angle beyond PCOS and postpartum
recommendations.detail: One campaign is a single point of failure. Worth exploring a Pilates or low-impact strength angle given category demand trends this year.
